paragraphs: Rav Natan bar Mar Ukva — [he] said in the name of Rav Yehuda, Berakhot 13b.[^1]

notes.text: אמר רב and יהודה join across the line break. “In the name of” makes Hyman’s terse transmission formula explicit; Natan reports Rav Yehuda, not the reverse. יג:. gives 13b under the colon convention; no named edition is independently checked. Both Rav titles and Mar are written in full.
